title: Symbolic: design of improved user function interfaces, with the dense linear algebra
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.3: a design of the symbolic user functions with vectors and matrices as first-class arguments and the dense linear algebra fully in symbolic, for decision.
releaseNotes: User functions take vectors and matrices as first-class arguments: read-only numpy views for Python user functions, named vectors and matrices for symbolic ones, which compute with numpy's operators and functions; results of any size are returned without allocation, matrix results dense or sparse.
